review:
[maya · changes] Harness, aggregation (nearest-rank, rationals, k/n) and fail-loud on baseline_failed are good; 18 tests green; re-ran F2+x/system/s1 and F2+/snapshot/s2 locally twice: byte-identical to each other. T=40 ACCEPTED as deviation, written as ADR-06-metrics A4 (quote 'T=40' with every number). Changes: (1) F3 'never detected 0/20' is wrong framing: on the current tree F3 s1 raises a scope alert at t_inject=15 and suspends comms; in your bench the snapshot cells applied at t_rec=16, so they paused, i.e. a suspend happened. Scorer t_alert needs evidence_seqs to intersect b_prod; a deny record is never in b_prod, so t_alert/t0 are null. And the system cell got no_plan, which runner.py drops silently. Route the scorer binding to anaya. Re-check B3-53's scope with nisha before she 'fixes detection'. (2) runner: a 'no_plan' note after a pause must be listed in failures/notes, not scored silently. (3) The committed scores are stale: same cells on the current tree differ only in collateral_stall d (+6: 388 vs 382, 387 vs 381). Find out whether that is code drift or container vs mac, then regenerate after the monitor/scorer fixes. (4) bench.md needs a header: T=40 (A4); snapshot and revert_culprit_only are oracle-assisted (given t_inject and culprit); collateral_stall is a proxy, basis s_star (A3 binding); add a p95 column (§4). (5) Explain F2+x held_honest 29 in bench.md: s1 has held_honest_outbox=27, i.e. triage's lineage items stay held because the conflict is flagged and the §4 approver never resolves flags. It is the cost of the flag, not a wrong revert, and should be read next to C=21/254. Same for revert_culprit_only's 27 (outbox untouched). (6) H=0 is §4 scope: run H=0 for F2+ and F2+x at least, plus a D10 contrast row (system, --hold 0 --no-lineage-hold) for those two faults. run_cell needs a no_lineage_hold flag. Other faults at H=0 can be deferred if listed in bench.md.

[maya · changes] All prior asks met: A5 F3 tti 0/0 ttc 1 20/20, no_plan listed, T=40, labels, p95, H=0 tables, revert_culprit_only F3 failures listed. tests/bench+score 20 passed. One change. The D10 contrast result is real, not a bug, but bench.md reads it wrong. Cause: --pause-on-alert + instant apply. In F2+ s1 the tainted payment ob-16 is queued at tick 17 (crm iban t15 -> INV-0016 t16 -> payment t17), alert t17, H=0 release t18. The apply re-runs ob-15/16 and holds them before t18, so recovery itself supersedes the payment and the lineage hold has nothing left to do (contrast score.json = H=0 system except the flag). RT10 shows a leak because it runs with no recovery. Check I ran: F2+ s1 no_op (pause, no recovery) with --no-lineage-hold gives irreversible_tainted_released 10, R 29/29; the bench no_op H=0 with the hold gives 0. Asks: (1) add a no_op CONTRAST column (H=0, --no-lineage-hold) to the F2+/F2+x contrast tables, keep the system contrast; (2) rewrite the D10 reading note: the lineage hold covers the time between alert and the operator applying recovery; with an instant apply it is redundant for F2+; without a decision yet, 10 payments escape on s1 (give the 20-seed numbers). No contract change.

[maya · done] D10 contrast verified: CONTRAST rows labelled per B3-53/s3, separate tables, never aggregated with system cells. Per-seed no_op score.json: s1=10, total 245, F2+ and F2+x identical on all 20 seeds (plausible: no recovery, so the x conflict never comes into play before the hold decision). tests/bench+score 20 passed. Not committed.
